brand.name: SaVi Tech
brand.heroTitle: We design and build digital products that make your business look credible and work beautifully.
brand.heroLede: From brand launches to online stores to WhatsApp automations — SaVi Tech handles the digital side so you can focus on the business.
brand.bandText: We partner with ambitious founders and business owners to build high-performance storefronts, digital platforms, and automated operations. Transparent communication. Zero agency overhead.
aboutParagraphs: SaVi Technologies was established with a clear commercial focus: engineering web flagships, e-commerce stores, and digital automations that solve real operational bottlenecks.

The studio was co-founded by Sahera Banu (Creative Direction & Brand Strategy) and Vijay Prasad (Product Engineering & Systems Architecture). Together with our engineering and automation associates, we build resilient, high-speed digital infrastructure for growing brands.
We design and build bespoke web flagships, online stores, and automated business workflows that look established, run smoothly, and genuinely support business growth.
brand.aboutNote: Direct leadership accountability, senior craft, and transparent milestones on every engagement.
brand.servicesIntro: Clear services. No jargon. Real results for real businesses.
brand.teamIntro: SaVi Tech is led by multidisciplinary practitioners combining creative direction with systems engineering.
brand.contactIntro: Tell us what you're working on. Whether it's a new website, an online store, or automating your business — we'll reply with an honest plan within 24 hours.

projects.title: intru.in
projects.scope: Brand Identity, Custom Storefront, Checkout Optimization
projects.summary: A minimal, high-impact streetwear store built for fast drops and smooth mobile shopping.
projects.description: We built the full e-commerce experience for INTRU — an independent Indian streetwear label. Product drops, inventory sync, smooth UPI checkout, and a design that feels as sharp as the brand.

projects.title: Vyra Herbals
projects.summary: A natural hair care brand store with automated Pan-India delivery built in.
projects.description: We designed and launched the flagship store for Vyra Herbals — a 100% natural, chemical-free hair care brand. The site features product discovery tools, real customer reviews, and automated Shiprocket shipping that syncs across India without any manual work.

projects.title: Vyra Hair Tracker
projects.scope: Cross-Platform App, Routine Scoring, Photo Milestones
projects.summary: A companion app that lets customers track their hair health journey over 12 weeks.
projects.description: Built as a companion to Vyra Herbals, this app lets users log their hair care routine, track progress with weekly photos, and get automated reminders. Available on web — interactive sandbox preview is live.

projects.title: PhotoFrame PFS
projects.scope: Live Frame Visualizer, Dynamic Pricing, Custom Uploads
projects.summary: An interactive tool where customers upload a photo and see it inside a custom frame before ordering.
projects.description: We built a custom photo frame configurator for The Frame House. Customers upload their image, choose frame style, size, and matting, and instantly see the result in a room simulation — with live pricing calculated as they go.

projects.title: Doraemon Media
projects.scope: Video Sharing, Content Discovery, Modern UI
projects.summary: A modern media sharing platform with a clean, immersive viewing experience.
projects.description: A video content platform built with a focus on clean UX, fast media delivery, and smooth navigation. Built for sharing trailers, short-form video, and curated content.

projects.title: Campus Assist
projects.summary: A clean, easy-to-use digital platform for campus information and student assistance.
projects.description: Campus Assist is a digital utility platform designed to help students navigate campus resources, schedules, and information quickly. Clear layout, fast access, mobile-friendly.

services.title: Website Design & Brand Identity
services.summary: A website that makes your business look established and credible from the first second.
services.detail: We design bespoke websites that reflect your brand — not a template. Every layout is clean, balanced, and built to build trust with your visitors on arrival. This includes typography, color, imagery direction, and full responsive design for mobile and desktop.

services.title: Web Development & Engineering
services.summary: Fast, reliable, and smooth — built to load instantly and work on every phone.
services.detail: We write clean modern code that keeps your site running fast and looking great across all devices. No bloated plugins, no slow loading — just a website that works exactly the way it should.

services.title: Online Stores & E-Commerce
services.summary: Sell online confidently with a store designed to convert browsers into buyers.
services.detail: We build custom online stores with smooth product browsing, quick checkout, UPI and card payments, and automated order management. See intru.in and Vyra Herbals for live examples of what we build.

services.title: WhatsApp Business Automation
services.summary: Turn WhatsApp into an automatic sales and support tool — without any extra work from you.
services.detail: We set up automated WhatsApp systems that send order confirmations, delivery updates, and follow-ups to your customers. We also build lead capture bots that collect inquiries and route them to you instantly — all running 24/7, automatically.

services.title: Fulfilment & Business Automations
services.summary: Automate the repetitive work — shipping, payments, and operations — so you can focus on growth.
services.detail: We connect your store with Shiprocket for automatic shipping label creation, track payment reconciliations, send inventory alerts, and build custom internal dashboards. The result: less manual work, fewer mistakes, and more time for you.

services.title: Custom Web Tools & Interactive Platforms
services.summary: If your idea needs something that doesn't exist yet, we'll build it.
services.detail: From live product configurators and pricing calculators to full web applications — we design and build custom tools that give your customers a unique experience. See PhotoFrame PFS for a live example.

steps.title: 01 · Design
steps.text: We start by understanding your business, your customers, and your goals. Then we design the site — layout, look, and feel — before writing a single line of code.

steps.title: 02 · Build
steps.text: We build your site with clean, modern code — fast to load, smooth to use, and reliable on every device. You see progress at every milestone.

steps.title: 03 · Launch
steps.text: We test, optimise, and launch your site. After launch we make sure everything works perfectly — and you have full ownership of everything we built.
